newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnlines says has option to up BTL stake.
newsitem.headline: Finnlines says has option to up BTL stake.

text.p: Finnish cargo shipping group Finnlines Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had an option to increase its ownership in Swedish firm BTL to 27.5 percent of shares from 20.8 percent.

Finnlines said it had an option to buy Swedish Walleniusrederierna AB's shares in Bilspedition Transport & Logistics AB, which would raise Finnlines' ownership in BTL to 37.9 percent of votes from 24.8 percent.
"Walleniusrederierna has given Finnlines rights, based on an option valid until March 31, 1997, to acquire Walleniusrederierna's shares in ... BTL," Finnlines said.
